tool.name: generate-azure-finops-review
tool.description: Read-only monthly Azure FinOps review of the configured subscriptions (Cost Management Query API, budgets, Azure Advisor and Azure Resource Graph, Reader only): last month's cost and change, month to date and forecast against the budget, where the money goes, cost per project (from a project tag it detects or you set), unusual days and month-over-month jumps, idle and orphaned resources, Advisor savings, commitment coverage and allocation readiness, with a prioritised action list. Writes an offline HTML report with a project filter, a JSON snapshot and three CSV files. Never changes anything.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: report (default: HTML + JSON + findings CSV + cost-by-resource CSV + cost-by-project CSV), query (bounded chat view, no files) or self_test (complete report from built-in SIMULATED data, no network).

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Only with operation=query: summary (default), actions, anomalies, budgets, savings, resources, projects, allocation or coverage.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Only with operation=query: maximum rows, 1-50 (default 15); answers are capped to 3,500 bytes.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Only with operation=query: one project name (case-insensitive, Unallocated accepted); summary, actions, savings, resources and projects then show that project only.

parameters.name: project_tag
parameters.description: Optional tag name that names the project for this run (or up to 5 comma-separated, in priority order), for example Proyecto. Overrides PROJECT_TAG_KEYS and the automatic detection.

skill.name: azure-finops-review
skill.description: Read-only monthly FinOps review of the whole Azure environment (Cost Management, budgets, Azure Advisor, Azure Resource Graph) with cost trend, where the money goes, cost per project, unusual days and jumps, budgets and forecast, savings, allocation readiness and a prioritised action list.

agent.name: finops-reviewer
agent.handoffDescription: Read-only Azure FinOps reviewer: monthly cost review of the whole environment with trend, where the money goes, cost per project, unusual days and jumps, budgets and forecast, savings (Advisor, idle and orphaned resources, commitments), allocation readiness and prioritised actions.

schedule.name: Azure FinOps - Monthly cost review
schedule.description: Every month on the 3rd at 07:00 UTC, when the previous month's costs have settled: read-only FinOps review of the whole environment with trend, where the money goes, cost per project, anomalies, budgets, savings, allocation readiness and prioritised actions.
schedule.agentPrompt: @finops-reviewer Run the monthly Azure FinOps review (operation=report). Give me the links to the HTML report, the JSON snapshot and the three CSV files first, then the verdict, the headline numbers, the cost per project and which tag identifies the projects, the prioritised actions with their estimated monthly savings, the budgets at risk, the unusual days and jumps, the allocation readiness and the coverage.
